`Norms are not always effective to promote behavior change, but they can be when presented in the right way'.

(1) presenting normative messages can increase the adoption rate of energy conservation measures, (2) how the normative message is presented affects which measures are chosen and that (3) presenting normative information can increase perceived feasibility, which can lead to more adoption.
